description: This Java source file defines the AuthenticationEndpoint class, which implements an AMQP endpoint for handling authentication token retrieval, using Vertx and Proton libraries. It manages link attachment events to transfer security tokens to clients over AMQP.

classes.name: AuthenticationEndpoint
classes.description: A Spring component that sets up an AMQP endpoint to handle authentication token requests, managing message sending over AMQP connections.

methods.description: Handles the event when an AMQP link is attached, setting QoS and sending a token message if the link supports AT_LEAST_ONCE delivery.
